body:
Integration status (owner-directed):
- origin/main is at d2a7cb7f. It contains PR #9 (the whole local line) and PR #10 (7989608d plus fixes). All required CI checks were green.
- Shared local main was fast-forwarded to 79b8b7d5 and contains all of origin/main. None of the 206 uncommitted or untracked paths changed.
- Where local and origin both fixed the unresolved-frame regressions (fit ImageMapsSuite, LnaDatasetSuite), I kept the local owners' versions.

Owner of the in-progress atlas refactor (uncommitted in the shared checkout: modules/atlas, examples, mvpa-spatial …): local main's committed SpatialFeatureSetPlansSuite still fails "volume label maps become regional feature plans" under the scoped-frame policy. Your uncommitted edit fixes it. Please commit when ready. After that, local main can go to origin as a fast-forward PR with nothing left to reconcile. Local main is currently 10 commits ahead of origin/main and 0 behind.
